stories.title: SUS amplia nova vacina pneumocócica para idosos a partir de 85 anos

en.title: SUS expands new pneumococcal vaccine for elderly aged 85 and older
en.summary: Brazil's Health Ministry expanded access to the pneumococcal 20 vaccine to people aged 85 and older on Monday. The vaccine was added to the national immunization program in June.

stories.title: PGR questiona Fachin se Mendonça se deu andamento a pedido da PF sobre autoridade com foro

en.title: Attorney General questions Fachin whether Mendonça acted on Federal Police request regarding authority with special jurisdiction
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General asked Supreme Court president Edson Fachin whether Justice André Mendonça addressed a Federal Police request from March 2026 concerning financial intelligence about an official with special jurisdiction.

stories.title: Taxista aquático é investigado por homicídio após colisão com morte de italiano e desaparecimento de brasileira em Veneza

en.title: Water taxi pilot investigated for manslaughter after collision resulting in Italian death and Brazilian woman's disappearance in Venice
en.summary: An Italian water taxi pilot is being investigated for maritime manslaughter following a collision in Venice that killed a 25-year-old fisherman and resulted in the disappearance of a 26-year-old Brazilian woman.

stories.title: Quem era o empresário que morreu após bater em poste na Rodovia Assis Chateaubriand

en.title: Who was the businessman who died after hitting a pole on Assis Chateaubriand Highway
en.summary: A businessman died after his vehicle struck a pole on Assis Chateaubriand Highway.

stories.title: Aprovação de Trump oscila para cima após atingir mínima histórica em pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos

en.title: Trump approval oscillates upward after reaching historic low in Reuters/Ipsos survey
en.summary: Donald Trump's approval rating rose slightly following a historic low, according to Reuters/Ipsos polling. Americans show increasing support for shifting Republican congressional majority to Democrats.

stories.title: Empresário morre após bater carro contra poste na Rodovia Assis Chateaubriand, no interior de SP

en.title: Businessman dies after car hits pole on Assis Chateaubriand Highway in São Paulo interior
en.summary: A businessman died in a car accident on a highway in São Paulo's interior region after his vehicle struck a pole.

stories.title: Cidade de São Paulo já registra o mês de setembro mais chuvoso desde 1943

en.title: City of São Paulo registers its rainiest September since 1943
en.summary: São Paulo has experienced its wettest September month since 1943, breaking a nearly 80-year rainfall record.

stories.title: PGR pede a Fachin que verifique se Mendonça liberou todos os documentos sobre pagamentos do Master

en.title: PGR asks Fachin to verify whether Mendonça released all documents on Master payments
en.summary: Brazil's attorney general's office requested that Justice Fachin verify whether Mendonça disclosed all documents related to Master payments.

stories.title: São Paulo tem o setembro mais chuvoso já registrado

en.title: São Paulo has the rainiest September on record
en.summary: São Paulo has experienced its wettest September since rainfall records began in 1943, with the city reaching this milestone in just 14 days according to Brazil's National Meteorology Institute.

stories.title: Fachin divulga rito genérico e será o 1º a votar em sessão histórica do STF sobre Vorcaro e Moraes

en.title: Fachin releases generic procedure and will be first to vote in historic STF session on Vorcaro and Moraes
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court announced procedures for a session scheduled for Tuesday to examine a Federal Police report regarding minister Alexandre de Moraes and his alleged communications with banker Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: STF confirma transmissão pela internet de sessão sobre Moraes

en.title: STF confirms online broadcast of session on Moraes
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court confirmed that Tuesday's session examining conversations between minister Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro will be broadcast live online and on TV Justiça, with security measures in place.

stories.title: Em 14 dias, cidade de São Paulo tem setembro mais chuvoso desde 1943

en.title: In 14 days, city of São Paulo has rainiest September since 1943
en.summary: São Paulo has become the wettest September in its historical rainfall records dating back to 1943, achieved within two weeks of the month according to Brazil's National Meteorology Institute data.

stories.title: CMN amplia em R$ 2 bilhões limite para que Estados e municípios contratem crédito

en.title: CMN increases by R$ 2 billion limit for States and municipalities to contract credit
en.summary: Brazil's Monetary Policy Council approved an increase of R$ 2 billion in the annual credit limit for states, municipalities and the Federal District. The decision allows additional borrowing of R$ 1.5 billion with federal government guarantees this year.

stories.title: PGR pede que Mendonça diga se houve decisão para Coaf revelar autoridades envolvidas na rede de pagamentos de Vorcaro

en.title: PGR asks Mendonça whether decision was made for Coaf to reveal authorities involved in Vorcaro payment network
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General's Office requested that Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça confirm whether he issued a ruling requiring the Financial Activities Council to share intelligence reports about the payment network of former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro involving officials with special jurisdiction.

stories.title: CVM tem novo portal para receber reclamações e denúncias

en.title: CVM launches new portal to receive complaints and reports
en.summary: Brazil's Securities Commission launched a new citizen service system allowing investors to make inquiries, file complaints and submit reports related to the capital markets.

stories.title: Selic deve cair a 13,75%, mas 4Intelligence vê pouco espaço para novos cortes adiante

en.title: Selic expected to fall to 13.75%, but 4Intelligence sees little room for further cuts ahead
en.summary: A 0.25 percentage point reduction in the Selic rate is expected this week, likely marking the final cut in the current monetary easing cycle, according to an economist. Further cuts remain possible but face significant uncertainty.

stories.title: Enel Rio anuncia plano para enfrentar ‘Super El Niño’

en.title: Enel Rio announces plan to face 'Super El Niño'
en.summary: Enel Rio has unveiled an operational plan to address effects from the forecasted strong El Niño phenomenon in the second half, involving hiring new staff, establishing operational bases, and upgrading electrical grid equipment across its 66 municipalities.
